note: Edits to the OSM layout for the Old Course, written by make_edits.py (generic resort edits, then course_edits.json); built into edited/course.geojson by pipeline/merge_edits.py.

add.reason: 20 golf=path ways inside the boundary, not read by s01: copied as golf=cartpath (free relief, drawn as paths)
8 golf=clubhouse buildings (s01 reads the golf tag first, so not as buildings): copied as buildings

the seven double greens (2/16, 3/15, 4/14, 5/13, 6/12, 7/11, 8/10; OSM maps each as one polygon with a pin for each hole) cut into one part per hole by split_double_greens.py (perpendicular bisector of the two holes' OSM pins; each hole line ends on its own pin), so each hole has its own centre, pin spots and putting views; the game treats the two halves as one putting surface (round.ts greenPartners: no wrong-green relief on the other half)

the North Sea (St Andrews Bay) and the Eden estuary from OSM's coastline (pipeline/propose_sea.py): a red penalty area wherever it lies (red_water_osm; developer's brief 2026-11-13: the Eden estuary is a penalty area)

the OB line: the Old, New and Jubilee polygons joined and cut to the world (make_boundary.py): out of bounds by the town, the Old Course Hotel, the wall and fence right of 14-16 and the Links' outer edge (developer's brief and the 2026 card's local rule 1); a shot onto the New or Jubilee Course is in play
